title: AWS Architecture Series #5 — KMS: The Encryption Layer Enterprises Get Half Right
excerpt: Enterprises enable encryption everywhere but build a flat key structure — one CMK per account, sometimes one for the entire organisation. When a single compromised role can decrypt RDS snapshots, S3 buckets, and Secrets Manager values in the same call, you have compliance theatre, not security depth.

title: AWS Architecture Series #4 — EventBridge: The Enterprise Event Bus Enterprises Get Wrong
excerpt: Engineering teams bolt on EventBridge as a notification layer rather than a decoupling layer — services still call each other synchronously, then fire an event as an afterthought. The tight coupling remains; they have only added a second communication channel to debug.
